# Card

A bordered container for one item or group, with its title, content and actions.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Content first</span></p>

## When to use it

**In Content first:** Article previews.

- **Use it when:** A repeating unit of title, media and one destination or action.
- **Not when:** Records people compare cell by cell (a table), or a whole card as one big link that screen readers read as one.

Instead:

- [Table](./table.md): Records compared across rows.
- [Item](./item.md): A compact row in a list.

## How Content first uses it

<div class="odv-grid two"><div class="odv-dd"><div class="stage"><div class="odv-eyebrow">A card on the page</div><div style="margin-top:6px"><b style="color:var(--color-status-success)">Use</b> A border, no shadow</div><div><b style="color:var(--color-status-danger)">Not</b> A strong shadow</div></div><div class="cap">Cards stay flat on the page; shadows are for floating things.</div></div></div>

## Words

- Write to one person: "you", not "users".
- Short sentences with room to breathe.
- Explain why before asking for anything.
- Use: Read, Save for later, You, Next issue. Avoid: Click here, Submit, Users, Content.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Save
- `content.action.cancel`: Not now
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Browse guides

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

Test before you ship:

- [ ] One inner link or button names the destination; the rest is not one big link. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add card
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Tokens it reads

Card reads 5 tokens of its own, each an alias of a semantic token. Each row is one part: its own token, the semantic it aliases, and the value it ends at. A row marked Themeable changes between light and dark. Change a semantic and every component that reads it follows; override one of Card's tokens to change Card alone.
